name: a read answers the raw bytes, outside the envelope
description: The one success response in /api/** that is not the {data, error} envelope, and the reason the contract vocabulary grew a header assertion. The Content-Type is what the PHP client branches on: parseBinaryResponse takes the body as the file when the status is 200 and hands anything else to the envelope parser. A service that wrapped these bytes in JSON would break every download without changing a status code. Note the handle in the query string: it contains slashes, which is why it is a query parameter and not a path segment. The runner must have seeded this object; see README.md.
